newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia, China to sign an agreement this week to boost cooperation in the oil and petrochemical sectors.
- Private sector in Saudi Arabia launches drive to expand its market share in the Middle East and African countries.
- Share prices of Saudi Basic Industries Corp rise 13 percent to 405 riyals from 360 riyals within 23 days.
- Relatives of two British nurses charged with killing their Australian colleague in Saudi Arabia have offered to meet with the victim's family.
- Iran's president-elect Mahammad Khatami hopes for better relations with Saudi Arabia.
- Saudi Agriculture Bank extended loans worth 28 billion riyals to farmers by 1995.
- Makkah Construction Co raises 97 million riyals from sixth auction to sell flats in the kingdom.
